content: {"reasoning":"The denial is CO-197 for missing prior authorization; this payer offers neither a retroactive auth window nor peer-to-peer review, so those routes are foreclosed and would be process mistakes. Resubmitting (clean, with records, or corrected) would not cure the missing auth and risks a duplicate/repeat denial, and the balance can't be shifted to the patient since a provider-side auth failure isn't contractual patient share. The only compliant path to recover the allowed amount is a formal appeal arguing medical necessity, supported by the available documentation.","action":"appeal_with_necessity"}
